subject: VertexHealth observability onboarding — dashboards, traces, alerts
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.inference.com>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@vertexhealth.com>, Peter Cho <peter.cho@vertexhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0000
Subject: VertexHealth observability onboarding — dashboards, traces, alerts

Hi Aisha / Peter —

Thanks for signing up for Redwood Dedicated. I want to kick off the observability & ops onboarding so we can hand off implementation to your SREs with a clear set of artifacts: dashboards, trace hook examples, error taxonomy, alert routing, and an operational runbook.

Proposed approach (short):
- Week 0: Kickoff + environment/access checks
- Week 1: Instrumentation & trace hook template + sampling guidance
- Week 2: Dashboard templates + alert taxonomy mapping
- Week 3: Runbook draft + playbook handoff + post-install review

Attached are preliminary artifacts to speed the work: vertex_integration_checklist.xlsx and obs-routing-map.png. Please confirm a kickoff window (we're proposing Mon 2026-11-09 15:00 PT) and let me know any must-have constraints (sampling, retention, security).

Deliverables we'll own: Redwood playbook summary, trace hook snippets (server & client), alert-to-PagerDuty mapping.

Thanks —
Diego Fernandez
Implementation Lead, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: vertex_integration_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: obs-routing-map.png (image)]

From: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@vertexhealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 14:02:00 -0000
Subject: Re: VertexHealth observability onboarding — dashboards, traces, alerts

Diego —

Appreciate the clear plan. Monday 11/09 at 15:00 PT works for our team (Peter and I). A couple of asks on our side before kickoff:
- We have strict sampling limits on patient-facing services — target 10 traces/sec aggregate per service, and any change needs security approval.
- Can you share an example tracing hook for our Java-based API and a minimal dashboard (error rate + 95th latency + kv cache hit)?
- Our security team will need the retention/PII notes for traces/logs (SOC2).

I'll attach our high-level security requirements in the next email.

Thanks,
Aisha Malik
SRE Lead, VertexHealth
[will attach: vertex_security_requirements.pdf]

Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 10:30:00 -0000
Subject: Fwd: VertexHealth observability onboarding — dashboards, traces, alerts

Forwarding Aisha's note — quick internal coordination: please confirm owners and the minimal artifacts we must have at kickoff. My suggestions:
- Diego: kickoff + trace hook + playbook summary (owner)
- Grace: dashboard templates + Grafana panel examples (owner)
- Karthik: alert taxonomy + routing policies (owner)

Ask: we should include a simple severity table (S1/S2/S3) and map each Redwood alert (TokenLoss, ModelFallbackRate, HighLatencyP90, ErrorBurst) to a Vertex pager/team. Can someone draft the table before Friday so I can loop security?

Monica
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

On Tue, 03 Nov 2026 at 14:02, Aisha Malik wrote:
> Diego —
> 
> Appreciate the clear plan...

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.inference.com>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@vertexhealth.com>, Peter Cho <peter.cho@vertexhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 13:08:00 -0000
Subject: Re: VertexHealth observability onboarding — dashboards, traces, alerts

Aisha / Peter —

Thanks for the heads up on sampling and security. Quick answers and attachments:
- Sampling: we can enforce a client-side sampler + server sampler to target ~10 traces/sec. We'll provide a Java snippet for okhttp and a server-side filter for your API (attached as examples).
- Traces/Retention: by default traces are stored 30 days; we can configure shorter retention for PII-sensitive spans. We'll produce a short SOC2 note for your security team.
- Dashboards: attached is a minimal dashboard template (panels: Error Rate, Latency P95, KV Cache Hit Rate) and a Grafana JSON export that your dashboards team can import.

Attachments: redwood_obs_playbook_summary.pdf, trace_hook_java_example.txt, grafana_import_minimal.json

I'll open a Jira ticket for alert mapping (ONB-462) and ask Karthik to draft the severity table by EOD Friday. Can you confirm the PagerDuty integration endpoint and whether you prefer alerts to go to a single service or routed by environment (prod/staging)?

Diego
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_obs_playbook_summary.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: trace_hook_java_example.txt (text)]
[Attachment: grafana_import_minimal.json (json)]

From: Peter Cho <peter.cho@vertexhealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@vertexhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0000
Subject: Re: VertexHealth observability onboarding — dashboards, traces, alerts

Diego —

Confirming: we will enforce the 10 traces/sec cap per service. Security requires the SOC2 retention note before any data flow; Aisha will route that. For alerts: we prefer routing by environment (prod -> PD service VH-Prod, staging -> VH-Staging). I'll attach our security doc for completeness (vertex_security_requirements.pdf).

Also: we use SHA-256-signed webhooks for PD; can you confirm Redwood can sign alert payloads?

Thanks,
Peter Cho
Director, Platform Engineering
VertexHealth
[Attachment: vertex_security_requirements.pdf (PDF)]

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.inference.com>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@vertexhealth.com>, Peter Cho <peter.cho@vertexhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 16:30:00 -0000
Subject: Re: VertexHealth observability onboarding — dashboards, traces, alerts

All —

Summary & next steps before kickoff (Monday 11/09, 15:00 PT):
1) Security note (SOC2/retention): Diego to send condensed SOC2 trace retention addendum by Monday morning. (ACTION: Diego)
2) Severity table & alert mapping (ONB-462): Karthik to draft and share by EOD Friday; Monica to review and then share with Vertex security. (ACTION: Karthik / Monica)
3) Tracing code samples: Diego to attach Java okhttp snippet and server filter (delivered).
4) PagerDuty routing: Vertex will provide PD service IDs and webhook signing secret (Peter to share).
5) Kickoff agenda & calendar: joining link here: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=vh_onb_kickoff_20261109 — please accept.

I'll produce the SOC2 trace addendum and a one-page playbook summary for your security team first thing Monday. If anything else is urgent, flag here and I'll escalate.

See you Monday —
Diego Fernandez
Implementation Lead, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_obs_playbook_summary.pdf (PDF)]
